claims.text: Macrolides = first-line for pertussis; azithro preferred.
claims.quote: Macrolide antibiotics are the first-line treatment for pertussis, with azithromycin preferred
Alternative macrolides include clarithromycin and erythromycin
For patients who cannot tolerate macrolides, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole is an appropriate alternative in individuals older than 2 months.

claims.text: PEP: the same macrolide regimens (typically azithro).
claims.quote: The same macrolide regimens used for treatment (typically azithromycin) are recommended for prophylaxis.
